description: §38.5.1 (S479) — a `<schema>` table with two columns marked `primary key` is E-SCHEMA-018 (Error). SQLite refuses the table at CREATE ("table has more than one primary key"), so a program that compiled would ship DDL that cannot run. The positive twin is schema/schema-018-composite-key-pos (a key over several columns written as one table-level `PRIMARY KEY (a, b)` in raw DDL).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — the rest of S478 hand-off §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 4 (gap g-boot-schema-second-pk-code-s478)
rationale: §38.5.1: "Exactly one column per table MAY be designated `primary key`." "A table with more than one `primary key` SHALL be a compile error (**E-SCHEMA-018**): two columns of one table each marked `primary key`, or one column marked twice …"

codes: severity:code 'E-SCHEMA-018' did not fire (expected severity error)
